scripts.title: PinguinRVS
scripts.features:
Aim Features
This script includes a highly customizable aimbot to enhance your gameplay. Use the aim key to toggle it on or off with ease. The FOV circle lets you visualize your aiming range and offers multiple customization options to suit your needs. Adjust sensitivity for smoother aim transitions and use prediction to improve accuracy on moving targets. The triggerbot feature automatically shoots when your target aligns, and you can choose from different aimbot methods for a personalized experience. Additionally, the HitPart selector allows you to aim at specific body parts for precision targeting.

Visuals Features
Stay ahead with a range of ESP options to improve your awareness. Highlight players with customizable 2D boxes, including filled box options. Names ESP displays player names for easy identification, while tracer ESP draws lines to track movements. Chams ESP makes players visible through walls, and the headdot ESP highlights head positions with clear markers. Each ESP feature comes with adjustable settings, giving you full control over how information is displayed.

Miscellaneous Features
The script offers several features to enhance movement and overall gameplay. Modify your walkspeed for faster navigation or use the mouse click teleport to instantly move across the map. The noclip feature allows you to pass through walls and objects effortlessly. Use the spinbot feature to confuse opponents with rapid spinning movements. For flying, you can choose between standard flying or CFrame flying for advanced mobility. Adjust flying speed using the included slider for complete control.

Configuration Features
Easily manage your script settings with the built-in configuration system. Save your preferred configurations for future use, load saved configurations anytime, and enable auto-load to ensure your favorite settings are applied automatically. Additional options make managing your gameplay experience simple and efficient.

scripts.script:
local CoreGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
    CoreGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Tbao Hub",
        Text = "By thaibao7444 discord.gg/yJcDBkV39U",
        Icon = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=15485121479&w=150&h=150",
        Duration = math.huge,
        Callback = AllowRunServiceBind,
    })



getgenv().enabled = true
getgenv().aimpart = "HumanoidRootPart" --Head


local replicated_storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local utility = require(replicated_storage:FindFirstChild("Modules").Utility)

local function getPlayersOrEntities()
    local entities = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            table.insert(entities, child)
        elseif child.Name == "HurtEffect" then
            for _, hurtPlayer in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                if hurtPlayer.ClassName ~= "Highlight" then
                    table.insert(entities, hurtPlayer)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return entities
end

local function isEnemy(player)
    if not getgenv().teamcheck then
        return true 
    end
    return player.Team ~= players.LocalPlayer.Team 
end

local function getClosestPlayer()
    if not getgenv().enabled then return nil end

    local closest, closestDistance = nil, math.huge
    local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
    local character = localPlayer.Character

    if not character then return nil end

    for _, player in ipairs(getPlayersOrEntities()) do
        if player == localPlayer then continue end
        if not player:FindFirstChild(getgenv().aimpart) then continue end
        if not isEnemy(player) then continue end 

        local position, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(player[getgenv().aimpart].Position)
        if not onScreen then continue end 

        local center = Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
        local distance = (center - Vector2.new(position.X, position.Y)).Magnitude

        if distance < closestDistance then
            closest = player
            closestDistance = distance
        end
    end

    return closest
end

local oldRaycast = utility.Raycast
utility.Raycast = function(...)
    local arguments = { ... }

    if #arguments > 0 and arguments[4] == 999 then
        local closest = getClosestPlayer()
        if closest then
            arguments[3] = closest[getgenv().aimpart].Position
        end
    end

    return oldRaycast(table.unpack(arguments))
end

local function toggleTableAttribute(attribute, value)
    for _, gcVal in pairs(getgc(true)) do
        if type(gcVal) == "table" and rawget(gcVal, attribute) then
            gcVal[attribute] = value
        end
    end
end

toggleTableAttribute("ShootSpread", 0)
